purpose: Protected failing-first tests for inert untrusted LFG, custom-command and feed reply echoes

commands.core: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot-core --test untrusted_lfg_echo_acceptance --test untrusted_feed_echo_acceptance --no-fail-fast -- --nocapture
commands.custom: TWO_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://agent_test:@agent-testdb:5432/two_bot_test_local python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot-discord --features db --test untrusted_custom_command_echo_acceptance -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
commands.controls: TWO_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://agent_test:@agent-testdb:5432/two_bot_test_local python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test --workspace --features two-bot-discord/db --test untrusted_lfg_echo_acceptance --test untrusted_feed_echo_acceptance --test untrusted_custom_command_echo_acceptance --no-fail-fast ordinary_ -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
commands.hostedFullSweep: gh workflow run nightly.yml --ref test/untrusted-reply-echoes-acceptance -R TogetherWeOwn/two-bot-next

contract.lfg: Parse rejected role keys through the real public parser; preserve BadKey classification, the 128-raw-character echo bound, ordinary copy, valid roles, and BadSlots/DuplicateKey/ReservedKey distinctions. Fold newlines; do not display hostile Markdown/backticks as active syntax.
contract.feeds: All four pause/resume confirmation renderers, including already-paused/already-enabled, keep stable-ID controls byte-identical. Hostile IDs must not break out of inline-code framing. An escaped backtick inside a single-backtick code span is NOT an accepted fix.
contract.custom: Actual Twilight interaction/router/service/store/executor replies: hostile absent-delete names, mention-shaped composite input, and valid __forged__ names across save/delete/missing/changed/unchanged toggle outcomes. Preserve management authority, private acknowledgement, neutral mentions, bounded content, existing absent-delete audit code/reason, and registry publication/no-public-send behavior.
contract.oraclePolicy: Literal golden fixtures accept existing inspect-style backslash escaping or existing inert-style punctuation removal where both are safe. Feed inspect-style output must be outside inline code; stripped output may retain trusted code framing. Underscore command names require escaping because inert does not remove underscores. Core mention pills may remain literal; actual Discord custom replies require empty allowed_mentions and neutralized mass mentions.
contract.bounds: LFG bounded hostile prefix and stable raw ASCII prefix; feed exact 128-UTF16-unit emoji ID; all captured custom replies and feed fixtures <=2000 UTF-16 units. No new sanitizer or policy implementation in tests.
contract.controls: Five baseline-compatible tests: two LFG controls, two feed controls and one routed custom-command control. Expected hostile failures are three LFG, four feed and three custom tests; these counts are expectations until verified execution.
contract.safety: Only test files and this manifest change. Disposable TestDatabase fixture with explicit teardown; local Discord double only. No real Discord, production/staging DB, migration, source change, weakening of gates, or log escaping. No implementation diff was read before fixture authoring.

existingRawLfgPin.notes: This pin asserts BadKey contains 128 raw k characters and Display echoes them. Its current all-k fixture is compatible with escaping: leave its bound and enum assertions intact. New protected hostile-key goldens supersede any inference that raw hostile punctuation should be displayed. If a Builder design requires changing the existing pin, request an author-controlled correction on the acceptance card; never silently edit it. This tests-only handoff does not write a source file merely to rename a compatible unit test.

ciRoute: Core tests run in the existing workspace integration lane; custom target needs two-bot-discord/db (enabled by the bot workspace dependency in the check matrix). An isolated core-only invocation does not establish custom coverage. Nightly all-features --no-fail-fast sweep reaches all three targets despite intended RED. Require a nonzero four-case custom test receipt, not a zero-test binary.
handoff: Consume the exact pushed SHA recorded in the issue handoff document. Verify every protected file SHA-256 before and after implementation. Never edit protected acceptance files; return oracle corrections to the Test Author.

These are deliberately failing-first tests, not a standalone implementation PR. Do not merge a RED tests-only branch. The Builder ships implementation and unchanged tests together with exact-head CI, independent review and verified squash auto-merge.
Bounded Cargo refusal exit 75 is not RED, a compile pass or a test pass. Execution evidence is recorded separately in the issue document.

Reuse existing escape helpers; preserve refusal codes/reasons and ordinary-input bytes. Review the three named sites and same-shape siblings. Builder owns implementation, evidence inventory in PR body, review fixes, GREEN and delivery.
